using namespace std;

const long long MOD = 998244353;

vector<long long> factors(long long n) {
    vector<long long> res;
    for (long long i = 1; i <= sqrt(n); i++) {
        if (n % i == 0) {
            res.push_back(i);
            if (i != n / i) {
                res.push_back(n / i);
            }
        }
    }
    sort(res.begin(), res.end());
    auto last = unique(res.begin(), res.end());
    res.erase(last, res.end());
    return res;
}

long long inv_mod(long long n) {
    long long base = n, res = 1, exp = MOD - 2;
    while (exp) {
        if (exp & 1) res = (res * base) % MOD;
        base = (base * base) % MOD;
        exp >>= 1;
    }
    return res;
}

long long give(vector<vector<long long>>& l1, vector<vector<long long>>& l2) {
